summary: First-finish smoke test of WorkMate AI. All backend APIs (auth, documents, employees, settings PUT, automations, chat SSE stream) return correct data. All 11 frontend flows pass: landing, RTL toggle, login navigation, wrong-cred error, admin login+all sidebar tabs (Dashboard/Knowledge=4 docs/Employees=4/Settings/Automations), employee login, suggested-question chat with streaming response ending in Source badge, and history persistence.
passed: POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 Invalid email or password
GET /api/documents returns 4 seeded docs (employees.csv, remote_work_policy.pdf, leave_policy.pdf, it_security_guidelines.pdf)
GET /api/automations returns Leave Request + IT Support
POST /api/chat/stream SSE emits meta -> delta chunks -> done, answer ends with 'Source: leave_policy.pdf'
Landing loads with brand-link, lang toggle sets document.dir=rtl
Login page: fill-admin-btn and fill-employee-btn helpers work
Wrong credentials show error toast on UI
Admin login redirects to /admin; sidebar navigates Dashboard/Knowledge/Employees/Settings/Automations
Knowledge tab lists all 4 seeded documents
Employees tab lists all 4 seeded employees
Employee login redirects to /chat; suggested-0 click triggers streaming AI response with Source badge (LLM integration via Emergent Universal Key working)
notes: 1 console 401 error observed is from the intentional wrong-credentials negative test (expected). Claude Sonnet 4.5 LLM streaming is functional and returns contextually correct answers with sources.
